source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: As your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase) begins, select an enemy unit this **PSYKER** can see. Through phase end, every attack by a model in the Sorcerer’s unit gets +1 to its [Hit roll](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls) against that enemy.
